'''Coniel''' was a young [[Ghostling]] slave [[Gender/Legends|boy]] that was rescued from the sand drains of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], while Skywalker was attempting to free [[Arawynne]] and the other Ghostlings from [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
